title: Conditions raised by zupdf — zupdf-conditions
text: Every error zupdf raises carries condition class, can caught kind rather matching message, may change. Every class inherits zupdf_error, inherits error. carries detail, pdfio's message one.

title: Conditions raised by zupdf — zupdf-conditions
text: zupdf_invalid_argument argument unusable: unknown page, bad colour, limit positive whole number. Carries arg, argument fault. zupdf_parse_error pdfio refused file object. Carries object, object number, pdfio named one. zupdf_password_error file encrypted password given opened . zupdf_limit_error limit reached. Carries limit, argument's name, "max_stream", limit_value. zupdf_unsupported_input input uses something zupdf support, WebP image AES-256 writing. zupdf_write_error pdfio refused write, closed writer used. zupdf_font_error font file read. zupdf_io_error file, temporary file connection failed. zupdf_encoding_error Extracted text valid UTF-8 mapping. Warnings carry class zupdf_warning.

what: zupdf: Read, Assemble and Write 'PDF' Files — zupdf-package
title: zupdf: Read, Assemble and Write 'PDF' Files — zupdf-package
text: Opens 'PDF' files reads metadata, pages, objects, streams, fonts, images text reading order; copies pages files split, merge, rotate reorder , sets metadata, permissions encryption; writes new 'PDF' files R text, paths images. Uses bundled copy 'pdfio' library (https://github.com/michaelrsweet/pdfio), system library beyond 'zlib' required. Untrusted input bounded limits size, object count, stream size nesting depth. Pages never rendered images.

title: Build information — zupdf_info
text: Reports bundled pdfio version, patches applied , zlib linked , pdfio features build lacks, default limits.

title: Build information — zupdf_info
text: list class zupdf_info elements: pdfio_version: version bundled pdfio, e.g. "1.6.5". ttf library ships inside release. patches: local patches applied , order. zlib_version: version zlib linked build time. absent: features later pdfio releases build lacks, "lzw" decoding. limits: default max_size, max_objects, max_stream, max_depth max_pages pdf_open(). smoke_ok: TRUE bundled pdfio wrote one-page file memory.
